references.text: The lot was cast to distribute the land, the same method used in Joshua 18:6
Joshua cast lots for the people at Shiloh before the Lord and divided the land among the children of Israel
The land was to be distributed by casting lots, as Moses received command from the Lord
The instruction to distribute the land by casting lots according to the size of the tribes
Moses commanded that the land should be distributed by casting lots to the nine and a half tribes
The lot is cast into the lap, but every decision comes from the Lord - the principle behind casting lots
The lot decides disputes and separates between the mighty - the role of the lot in decisions
Casting lots was used to choose Matthias as an apostle, a continuation of the practice of seeking God's will through the lot
